_note: RAW BYTES carry the same key twice inside one object. 'all_pass' appears as true then false; 'classification' appears as canonical then hostile_control_fixture. RFC 8259 leaves duplicate object keys undefined; python json.load and JS JSON.parse both silently keep the LAST occurrence. Both values are physically present in the file (grep -c proves 2 each). A first-match / top-skimming reader sees all_pass:true, classification:canonical; every gate that parses the file acts on the LAST value.
